distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) reported 黑龙江（带岭），吉林（抚松）. 黄复生等 (2015) reported 黑龙江，吉林. These are literature-based reports; the mainland-China occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending checklist review.

host_note: Host names are retained as published, with separate source citations for 1984 and 2015; the latter may repeat earlier evidence rather than represent independent host confirmation. Host associations have not yet undergone independent review.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Orthotomicus golovjankoi Pyatnitskiy, 1930.
